analysis: Politics, conflict, social theory and cultural interpretation give several defensible starting points. Qualitative and historical methods complement textual and media analysis. No UCR course identified here supplies a full comparative study of Judaism, Christianity and Islam, scriptural interpretation as taught in the Utrecht foundation, or a sustained Middle East religious-history sequence. Course contributions remain provisional; full concepts, credit schedules and component alignment await the confirmed comparator.
